# Empathia Village

Official English website for a private villa development in Baie Lazare, Mahé, Seychelles. Information last reviewed: November 2026. Russian website: https://empathiavillage.ru/

- Approximately 30 private plots; the final number may change if adjoining plots are combined.
- Plots from 600 m². According to the project team, project-specific planning and legal documentation applies to the offered plots, including plots from 600 m². Supporting documents can be provided to prospective purchasers and their Seychelles lawyers before completion.
- Starting prices before final interior finishes: Villa Jane USD 890,000 (house from 140 m², plot from 600 m²); Villa Anna USD 1,300,000 (house from 240 m², plot from 600 m²); Villa Georgette USD 1,800,000 (house 350–450 m², plot from 1,500 m²); Villa Florance USD 2,000,000 (house from 350 m², plot from 1,500 m², 6 bedrooms in the proposed plan).
- Base scope: levelled building plot, construction, finished façade and roof, windows and entrance doors, central utility connections, internal plumbing and electrical distribution, and preparation of walls, floors and ceilings for final finishes. Final finishes, kitchen equipment, furniture, lighting, smart home, air conditioning, pool and landscaping are priced separately for each client. The signed specification defines the exact works.
- For non-Seychellois purchasers, the Government Sanction procedure is handled before the relevant subsequent contractual stages. The project team assists; the Seychelles authority makes the formal decision. Freehold is subject to the applicable approval and legal process.
- Empathia Village provides assistance with the Government Sanction process as part of transaction support. Government duties, taxes, registration charges and other statutory fees are payable separately by the purchaser and are not included in advertised villa prices. If approval cannot be obtained despite the buyer meeting agreed conditions, the plot reservation amount is refunded under the reservation agreement.
- Before the transaction proceeds, the purchaser is informed about applicable government charges for the selected property and transaction structure.
- Residence Permit application support is available. The project team reports that some clients have received permits. Purchase does not automatically grant residence; the immigration authority decides individual applications.
- Owners may choose to let their villa; this is not prohibited within the estate. Applicable licences and taxes depend on the intended rental use. No rental return is guaranteed.
- Project-reported September 2026 status: 70% of plots prepared, first house roof and utility works underway, second house foundation started. Full estate development is planned through 2030; an individual villa follows its agreed contractual schedule.
- There is no guaranteed rental return, appreciation, residence status or citizenship.
